## Import

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)
library(broom)
library(glue)
library(plotgardener)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(sjPlot)
library(gtools)
setwd("~/gitcode/DNAm")
`%nin%` = negate(`%in%`) 
DATE = ymd(Sys.Date()) %>% str_replace_all("-", "")
```

```{r}
## Import 

adni <- read_csv('intermediate/adni.csv')
cog.df <- adni %>% 
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice_min(PHC_Visit) %>%
  ungroup()
mri.df <- read_csv('intermediate/mri.csv') %>%
  mutate(
    apoe = fct_relevel(apoe, "e3/e3")
  )
flbm.df <- read_csv('intermediate/flbm.csv')

adni %>% 
  select(RID, gbl_cog, months_c, nk_cell, z_dnam_bl)
```

## Analysis
### Global Cognition 
#### Baseline Models
```{r}
fitlmer.00 <- lmer(gbl_cog ~ months_c + (months_c  | RID), REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.00)

cog_bl_cov <- "months_c + age_bl + sex + educ + cdrsb_bl + apoe + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

fitlmer.01 <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bl_cov} + (months_c  | RID)")), 
                  REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.01)

fitlmer.02a <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl + {cog_bl_cov} + (months_c  | RID)")), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02a) 

fitlmer.02b <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_dnam_bl + {cog_bl_cov} + (months_c  | RID)")), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02b)

fitlmer.02c <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_mtcn_bl + {cog_bl_cov} + (months_c  | RID)")), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02c)
```

```{r}
cog_bllm_cov <- "age_bl + sex + educ_cat + cdrsb_bl + apoe + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl + causage_bl + tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl * causage_bl * tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl + causage_bl * tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl * causage_bl + tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  causage_bl + mtcn_bl * tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()

```

#### Longitudinal
```{r}

cog_lt_cov <- "months_c + age_bl*months_c + sex + educ_cat + cdrsb_bl*months_c + apoe*months_c + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

## Longitudional
fitlmer.03 <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03)

fitlmer.03a <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03a)
plot_model(fitlmer.03a, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_tl_bl"))

fitlmer.03b <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_dnam_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03b)
plot_model(fitlmer.03b, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_dnam_bl"))

fitlmer.03c <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_mtcn_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03c)
plot_model(fitlmer.03c, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_mtcn_bl"))

fitlmer.03d <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl*months_c + z_dnam_bl*months_c + z_mtcn_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"), REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03d)

plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_tl_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_dnam_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_mtcn_bl"))
```

```{r}

gbl_cog_bioage.res <- bind_rows(
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.03) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "baseline"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.03a) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "TL"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.03b) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "CausAge"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.03c) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "mtDNAcn"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.03d) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "BioAge")
  ) %>%
  relocate(outcome, model) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = signif(estimate, 2),
    std.error = signif(std.error, 2),
    p.value_fmt = if_else(
      p.value < 0.001,
      formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),  # scientific notation
      as.character(round(p.value, 3))),
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),              
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}{sig}")
  ) 
  
gbl_cog_bioage.res  %>% 
  select(-group) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

```

```{r}
gbl_cog_tl.p <- plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_tl_bl")) + 
  labs(
    x = "Months (Centered)", 
    y = "Global Cognition", 
  ) + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "TL")) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'bottom', 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

gbl_cog_dnam.p <- plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_dnam_bl")) + 
  labs(
    x = "Months (Centered)", 
    y = "Global Cognition", 
  ) + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "CausAge")) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'bottom', 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

gbl_cog_mtcn.p <- plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_mtcn_bl")) + 
  labs(
    x = "Months (Centered)", 
    y = "Global Cognition", 
  ) + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "mtDNAcn")) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'bottom', 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

gbl_cog_bioage.p <- cowplot::plot_grid(gbl_cog_tl.p, gbl_cog_dnam.p, gbl_cog_mtcn.p, nrow = 1, labels = c("A", "B", "C"))
gbl_cog_bioage.p

ggsave(glue("results/plots/gbl_cog_bioage_{DATE}.png"), plot = gbl_cog_bioage.p, width = 9, height = 4, units = 'in')

```

#### Interactions
```{r}

## Interaction

fitlmer.04a <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl*z_dnam_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.04a)
plot_model(fitlmer.04a, type = "pred", terms = c("z_dnam_bl", "z_tl_bl"))

fitlmer.04b <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl*z_mtcn_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.04b)
plot_model(fitlmer.04b, type = "pred", terms = c("z_mtcn_bl", "z_tl_bl"))


fitlmer.04c <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_dnam_bl*z_mtcn_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.04c)
plot_model(fitlmer.04c, type = "pred", terms = c("z_mtcn_bl", "z_dnam_bl"))

fitlmer.04d <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_mtcn_bl*z_tl_bl*z_dnam_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.04d)
```

```{r}

gbl_cog_x.res <- bind_rows(
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.04a) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "DNAmxTL"), 
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.04b) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "mtDNAcnxTL"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.04c) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "mtDNAcnxDNAm"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.04d) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL"),
) %>% 
  mutate(
    estimate = signif(estimate, 2),
    std.error = signif(std.error, 2),
    p.value_fmt = if_else(
      p.value < 0.001,
      formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),  # scientific notation
      as.character(round(p.value, 3))),              # decimal (3 places)
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),      
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}")
  ) 
  
gbl_cog_x.res  %>% 
  print(n = Inf)

```

### Cogntive Domains
#### Episodic Memory
```{r}

cog_lt_cov <- "months_c + age_bl*months_c + sex + educ_cat + cdrsb_bl*months_c + apoe*months_c + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

## Longitudional
fitlmer.mem_tl <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_tl_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

fitlmer.mem_dnam <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_dnam_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

fitlmer.mem_mtcn <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_mtcn_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

fitlmer.mem_bioag <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_tl_bl*months_c + z_dnam_bl*months_c + z_mtcn_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

summary(fitlmer.mem_bioag)
plot_model(fitlmer.mem_bioag, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_tl_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.mem_bioag, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_dnam_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.mem_bioag, type = "pred", terms = c("months_c", "z_mtcn_bl"))

## DNAm x mtCN
fitlmer.mem_dnam_mtcn <- lmer(glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_mtcn_bl*z_dnam_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni
  )
summary(fitlmer.mem_dnam_mtcn )

## DNAm x TL
fitlmer.mem_dnam_tl <- lmer(glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_dnam_bl*z_tl_bl*months_c +  {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni
  )
summary(fitlmer.mem_dnam_tl )

## TL x mtCN
fitlmer.mem_tl_mtcn <- lmer(glue("PHC_MEM ~  z_mtcn_bl*z_tl_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni
  )
summary(fitlmer.mem_tl_mtcn )

## TL x DNAm x mtCN
fitlmer.mem_bioag_x <- lmer(glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_mtcn_bl*z_dnam_bl*z_tl_bl*months_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (months_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )
summary(fitlmer.mem_bioag_x )
```

```{r}
mem.res <- bind_rows(
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.mem_tl) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "TL", predictor = 'TL'),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.mem_mtcn) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcn", predictor = 'mtDNAcn'),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.mem_dnam) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "CausAge", predictor = 'CausAge'),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.mem_bioag) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "BioAge"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.mem_dnam_tl) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "DNAmxTL"), 
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.mem_tl_mtcn) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcnxTL"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.mem_dnam_mtcn) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcnxDNAm"),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.mem_bioag_x ) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL"),
) %>% 
  mutate(
    estimate = signif(estimate, 2),
    std.error = signif(std.error, 2),
    p.value_fmt = if_else(
      p.value < 0.001,
      formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),  # scientific notation
      as.character(round(p.value, 3))),              # decimal (3 places)
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),      
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}")
  ) 
  
```

```{r}
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.lan_dnam) %>% mutate(outcome = 'lan', model = "CausAge", predictor = 'CausAge'),
  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.lan_bioag) %>% mutate(outcome = 'lan', model = "BioAge"),

  broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.lan_bioag_x ) %>% mutate(outcome = 'lan', model = "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL"),
) %>%

  )
```

```{r}
csf_coef.p <- csf.res %>%
  filter(term %in% c('mtcn', 'CausAge', 'TL_BP_ADJ')) %>%
  mutate(
    term = case_when(
      term == "mtcn" ~ 'mtDNAcn', 
      term == "CausAge" ~ 'CausAge', 
      term == "TL_BP_ADJ" ~ 'TL'
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = estimate, y = term)) + 
  facet_grid(rows = vars(outcome)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    x = "Coefficient Estimate (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(glue("results/plots/csf_bioage_{DATE}.png"), plot = csf_coef.p, width = 9, height = 4, units = 'in')


plot_model(ab42_dnamxtl.res, type = "pred", terms = c("CausAge", "TL_BP_ADJ")) +

    y = "AB42",

  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "TL")) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'bottom', 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

```{r}
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    x = "Coefficient Estimate (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
mri_coef.p

ggsave(glue("results/plots/mri_bioage_{DATE}.png"), plot = mri_coef.p, width = 9, height = 4, units = 'in')
```

## Summarize Results

```{r}
#| label: results_all

cog_summary.res <- bind_rows(
    mem.res, 
    exf.res, 
    lan.res, 
    vsp.res
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    endophenotype = 'Cognition',
    model = ifelse(str_detect(model, 'CausAge'), "DNAm", model),
    model2 = case_when(
      model %in% c('TL', 'DNAm', 'mtDNAcn') ~ 'Single',
      model == 'BioAge' ~ 'Joint', 
      str_detect(model, "x") ~ 'Interaction',
    ),
    model = case_when(
      model == 'BioAge' & str_detect(term, 'z_tl_bl') ~ 'TL',
      model == 'BioAge' & str_detect(term, 'z_mtcn_bl') ~ 'mtDNAcn',
      model == 'BioAge' & str_detect(term, 'z_dnam_bl') ~ "DNAm",
      TRUE ~ model
    ),
    outcome = fct_recode(outcome, 'Memory' = 'mem', "Language" = 'lan', 'Executive Function' = 'exf', 'Visuospatial ability' = 'vsp'),
    outcome = case_when(
      str_detect(term, "months") ~ paste0(outcome, " Decline"), 
      TRUE ~ outcome
    ),
    term = if_else(
      str_detect(term, ":"),
      map_chr(str_split(term, ":"), ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = ":")),
      term
    )
  ) %>% 
  relocate(outcome, model, model2) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "mtcn|dnam|tl")) %>%
  filter(!(model2 == 'Interaction' & !str_detect(term, ":"))) %>%
  filter(!(model2 == 'Interaction' & term %in% c("months_c:z_tl_bl", "months_c:z_dnam_bl", "months_c:z_mtcn_bl"))) %>%
  filter(!(model == "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL" & str_count(term, ":") < 2)) %>%
  filter(!(model == "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL" & str_count(term, ":") == 2 & str_detect(term, "months_c"))) %>%
  mutate(  
    term = model, 
    model = model2
  ) %>% 
  select(-model2)


res <- bind_rows(
  gbl_cog_bioage.res %>%
    # select(outcome, model, term, p.value) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "mtcn|dnam|tl")) %>%
    mutate(
      endophenotype = 'Cognition',
      outcome = ifelse(str_detect(term, "months"), 'Global Cognitive Decline', 'Global Cognition'), 
      model = ifelse(model == 'BioAge', 'Joint', 'Single'),
      term = case_when(
        str_detect(term, 'tl') ~ 'TL',
        str_detect(term, 'mtcn') ~ 'mtDNAcn',
        str_detect(term, 'dnam') ~ "DNAm",
      )
      ),
  
  gbl_cog_x.res %>%
    #select(outcome, model, term, p.value) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "mtcn|dnam|tl")) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, ":"))  %>%
    filter(term %nin% c("z_tl_bl:months_c", "z_dnam_bl:months_c", "z_mtcn_bl:months_c")) %>%
    filter(!(model == "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL" & str_count(term, ":") < 2)) %>%
    filter(!(model == "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL" & str_count(term, ":") == 2 & str_detect(term, "months_c"))) %>%
    mutate(
      endophenotype = 'Cognition',
      outcome = ifelse(str_detect(term, "months"), 'Global Cognitive Decline', 'Global Cognition'), 
      term = model,
      model = "Interaction",
      ), 
  
  cog_summary.res, 

  mri.res %>%
  #select(outcome, model, term, p.value) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "mtcn|causage|tl")) %>%
  mutate(
    endophenotype = 'MRI',
    model2 = case_when(
      model == 'bioage' ~ 'Joint', 
      str_detect(model, 'x') ~ 'Interaction', 
      TRUE ~ 'Single'
    ), 
    model = case_when(
      model == 'bioage' & str_detect(term, 'tl') ~ 'TL',
      model == 'bioage' & str_detect(term, 'mtcn') ~ 'mtDNAcn',
      model == 'bioage' & str_detect(term, 'causage') ~ "DNAm",
      TRUE ~ model
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!(model2 == 'Interaction' & !str_detect(term, ":"))) %>%
  filter(!(model == 'mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL' & str_count(term, ":") < 2)) %>%
  mutate(  
    term = model, 
    model = model2
  ) %>% 
  select(-model2), 

  csf.res %>%
    #select(outcome, model, term, p.value) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "mtcn|CausAge|TL")) %>%
      mutate(
      endophenotype = 'CSF',
      model2 = case_when(
        model == 'bioage' ~ 'Joint', 
        str_detect(model, 'x') ~ 'Interaction', 
        TRUE ~ 'Single'
      ), 
      model = case_when(
        model == 'bioage' & str_detect(term, 'TL') ~ 'TL',
        model == 'bioage' & str_detect(term, 'mtcn') ~ 'mtDNAcn',
        model == 'bioage' & str_detect(term, 'CausAge') ~ "DNAm",
        TRUE ~ model
      )
    )  %>%
    filter(!(model2 == 'Interaction' & !str_detect(term, ":"))) %>%
    filter(!(model == 'mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL' & str_count(term, ":") < 2)) %>%
    mutate(  
      term = model, 
      model = model2
    ) %>% 
    select(-model2)
)


res.df <- res %>% 
  select(endophenotype, outcome, model, term, p.value) %>%
  # pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      p.value < 0.05               ~ "\u2713",  # check mark ✓
      p.value >= 0.05 & p.value < 0.1 ~ "\u2022",  # bullet •
      p.value >= 0.1               ~ "\u2717"   # cross ✗
    ), 
    model = fct_relevel(model, 'Single', 'Joint','Interaction'), 
    term = fct_relevel(term, 'mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL'), 
    outcome = fct_relevel(outcome, 'Global Cognition', 'Global Cognitive Decline', 'Memory', 'Memory Decline')
  )
  
res.p <- ggplot(res.df, aes(x = outcome, y = term, label = signif, color = signif)) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # Angle the top labels

    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r}
  ) %>%
  select(outcome, model, term, out) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = outcome,
    values_from = out
  ) %>%
  unite("Global Cognition", c("Global Cognition", "Global Cognitive Decline"), sep = "; ") %>%
  unite("Memory", c("Memory", "Memory Decline"), sep = "; ") %>%
  unite("Executive Function", c("Executive Function", "Executive Function Decline"), sep = "; ") %>%
  unite("Language", c("Language", "Language Decline"), sep = "; ") %>%
```

```{r}
#| label: export_cog_results


cog_bioage.out <- bind_rows(
    gbl_cog_bioage.res, gbl_cog_x.res, 
    mem.res, 
    exf.res, 
    lan.res, 
    vsp.res
  ) %>%
  filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
  select(outcome, model, term, estimate, std.error, p.value_fmt, sig) %>%
  mutate(
    term = if_else(
      str_detect(term, ":"),
      map_chr(str_split(term, ":"), ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = ":")),
      term
    )
  ) %>%
  # Combine p.value_fmt and sig into one column
  unite(p, c("p.value_fmt", "sig"), sep = " ") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from   = model,
    values_from  = c(estimate, std.error, p),
    names_glue   = "{.value}_{model}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effect = ifelse(str_detect(term, "months"), "longitudinal", "baseline")
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    outcome, term, effect, 
    ends_with("_baseline"), 
    ends_with("_TL"), 
    ends_with("_CausAge"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcn"), 
    ends_with("_bioage"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcnxTL"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcnxDNAm"), 
    ends_with("_DNAmxTL"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL")
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome, effect)

cog_bioage.out

cog_bioage.out  %>%
  write_csv(glue('results/cog_results_{DATE}.csv'), na = "")
```
